title: Control and echo
acceptance_criteria: A control character (C0, DEL, C1, a bidi override or isolate) in a value a person gives is refused at write as refused:control-character, naming the field and code point, except a line feed where the field takes a line break, with CRLF stored as LF; text printed from a record or given is escaped as \u and four hex digits, text and JSON alike, with a line feed shown as \n on a one-line slot; YAML reserved scalars are written quoted (#366). checkpoint --pr takes only a number or an http(s) URL, an empty value removes it, and next, status, context and the checkpoint view show it; the journal post links only those forms (#353). The remaining error and output sites name the field and what it holds, never the value, proven by a black-box sweep (part of #367). A file: URL is checked like the path it carries, and USERNAME counts like USER and LOGNAME (REQ-records-006).

answers.constraints: Leif decided the scope on the issues: #366 "both. New values holding control characters are refused at write (except line breaks where a field allows them), and stored text is shown escaped when printed, as status and context already do", widened to C0/C1 controls, DEL and bidi overrides in every field, with a tab refused like any other control, since a survey of 22 repositories' records found none; #353 from his decision of 2026-11-18 (number or URL, shown in next, status, context and the checkpoint view; an empty value clears it), with #12 stored as 12 and pr written as a quoted string; #367 "approved. Errors name the field and the kind, never the offending text" and "Show it only if clean". Stacked on #407 (leaks-and-output), whose REQ-records-006 text it builds on; it modifies no requirement D1 (doctor-fix-safety) or #311 modifies. change.rs sites stay with G1. No new dependency. Failing tests first.
